name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. Anime providers prefer MAL/Jikan, then AniList, and fall back to TMDB/IMDb when anime metadata services are unavailable; proven changes are promoted to the main branch after validation.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using the shared Nexus anime identity layer. MAL/Jikan is preferred first, AniList is secondary, and strict TMDB/IMDb-backed Re:ANIME catalog matching remains available when anime metadata services fail. Re:ANIME's structured Flix API is then used for episode/server lookup and direct FlixCloud assets when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with wcostream.tv → wcoflix.tv → wcoforever.net fallback coverage, premium/mirror support, Season 0/special handling, strict series and episode ownership checks, and the separately gated Power Rangers resolver. Anime prefers MAL/Jikan, then AniList, then automatically falls back to TMDB aliases; non-anime bypasses anime databases entirely.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: Nexus API DIAG
scrapers.description: Temporary Nexus-only diagnostics provider for isolating Nuvio/runtime connectivity from TMDB, MAL mapping, AniList, Re:ANIME, FlixCloud, and WCO upstream failures. Remove after current upstream validation is complete.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus diagnostics

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix
scrapers.description: Experimental Asian drama/show provider using AsiaFlix's current v1 JSON API for title search, detail/episode lookup, and server resolution. Matches Nuvio TMDB/IMDb metadata against primary and alternate titles, preserves original-audio language labels, probes HLS quality where available, and intentionally refuses TV seasons above Season 1 until a safe season-title mapping is validated.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on current Yuzono/Keiyoushi AsiaFlix and CSX provider behavior

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider using Tubi's current anonymous-device bearer-token flow, strict TMDB/IMDb title matching, nested season/episode mapping, and clear HLS playback. Keeps the top two video quality levels with up to two distinct manifests per quality and skips DRM-only titles.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: AnikotoTV
scrapers.description: AnikotoTV with standardized DUB/SOFTSUB/DUB+SUBS output labels based on the provider's existing selectable caption tracks.
scrapers.author: piratezoro9
